title: App frame
summary: The whole app frame from data: header with brand, module picker, search and settings menu, a side nav built from a nav model, the breadcrumb trail above the page, and a footer. It routes nothing; the host sets the model and navigates.

props.name: brand
props.description: The brand text in the header.

props.name: brandHref
props.description: Where the brand links (a same-site path or an http(s) address); empty is plain text.

props.name: nav
props.description: Side nav rows: { id, title, href?, icon?, badge?, children? }[]. Empty draws no nav.

props.name: trail
props.description: Ids of the branches to open (the ancestors of the current row).

props.name: modules
props.description: The module picker: { id, title, href }[]. Fewer than two draws no picker. On a phone the list is the first row of the drawer instead, the one titled moduleTitle marked current.

props.name: moduleTitle
props.description: The active module, shown on the picker.

props.name: crumbs
props.description: The breadcrumb trail: { label, href? }[]; the last is the current page and is not a link. Empty draws none.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: The search field placeholder and name.

props.name: busy
props.description: Blocks the page behind a loading overlay.

props.name: searchItems
props.description: Search results, as pk-app-bar-search items: { id, label, group?, sub?, badge? }[]. The host computes them on pk-query.

slots.description: The page. Put the skip link target (<main id="pk-main">) here.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Footer content; the strip is drawn only with a child here.

events.name: pk-query
events.description: The search text changed (debounced); the host sets searchItems.

events.name: pk-select
events.description: A search result was chosen; the host navigates.

events.name: pk-theme-toggle
events.description: The Toggle theme item in the settings menu was chosen.

parts.name: module
parts.description: The active module title on the picker

a11y: Built from pk-app-shell, pk-navbar (label Main), pk-side-nav (label navLabel) and pk-breadcrumb (aria-current on the last crumb): landmarks, keyboard and focus are theirs. The menu control is named Toggle the menu. The skip link and main landmark belong to the page slot, since an id cannot be targeted across the shadow boundary.
mobile: The side nav is the drawer behind the menu control; the picker is not drawn (pk-navbar), the search collapses to an icon; the safe-area insets are the shell's.
